env_v1.ownership: Evidence package owns frozen items; broker owns admissions and audit; participant owns hypotheses/answer; operator evaluator owns private outcomes. See PLAN.md.
env_v1.authority: Each lane is operation-scoped below. No participant mutation of evidence, no public SQL or arbitrary paths, no evaluator feedback endpoint, no model/source refresh.
env_v1.shape_versions: two-store-environment-0.1 item schema; explicit JSON operation fields; opaque item IDs, source group, scope, units/clock, original-asset hash and rows. Private labels are never a public field.
env_v1.identity_scope: Source-group identity links duplicate presentations. Item IDs identify records, not independent physical entities. External corpus IDs remain external; simulation plots/years are separate.
env_v1.time_order: All scenario evidence predates/equal year 60. Requests record rationale/expectation before their response. Event timing/HTTP service time are separate from simulation time and unmeasured participant reasoning time.
env_v1.delivery_idempotency: Request IDs bind canonical operation/body. Same request replays its committed response; conflicting content fails 409. HTTP attempts count retries separately from logical acquisitions.
env_v1.commit_recovery: Broker serializes admission/final-answer writes with SQLite transactions; committed replay after restart is checked. Restore checks compressed and raw hashes and refuses conflicting destination bytes.
env_v1.retention: Versioned immutable evidence and private case snapshot in operator repository. Per-run audit outside Git retains full pre-acquisition request and response. No automatic eviction/refresh.
env_v1.resource_limits: One loopback broker per run; body at most 131072 bytes, catalogue page at most 50, record page at most 200, asset slice at most 65536 bytes. No lifetime inquiry action cap; workload/load/energy qualification is not claimed.
env_v1.errors: Invalid type/range/unknown fields 400, unauthorized token 401, future selectors 403, unavailable resource/route 404, conflicting replay/closed session 409, oversized body 413; no fabricated fallback.
env_v1.feedback_grounding: Frozen evidence exists before inquiry. Hypotheses never generate observations. Independent synthetic channels have no world input; real context and derived views are attributed. Private labels diagnose, not reward.

cases.conditions: Scripted fixture over actual authenticated HTTP, inquiry, replay/conflicts, request-content retention, bounds, denial, restart, final submission and offline scoring.
Actual raw/compressed hashes, original corpus pin, public tables, source groups, bounded time and deterministic policy replay.

feedback_reviews.analysis: Request/response and offline journal-read paths form a dependency group. The evaluator has no participant feedback lane; the broker never opens private outcomes. Frozen records cannot be changed by hypotheses or retries. Source-group IDs prevent duplicate confirmations. Final submission closes new acquisition; no oracle reward loop exists. Shared filesystem access would bypass this boundary and requires a separately isolated participant deployment.

findings.description: Owner filesystem access bypasses participant-only export; hostile deployment isolation is not qualified.
No EDI consumer, human run, varied unseen worlds or comparative evaluation.

review.scope_limit: Self-review of declared environment interfaces and actual scripted engineering checks only; no EDI capability or security deployment qualification.
